'''Sean Smallman''' handled retail and convention support at Decipher, working with the Product Champions, and is credited on the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] team (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001).
